headline: 코뿔소를 거꾸로
매달면 어떻게 됨?

lines.say: 코뿔소를 거꾸로 매달면 어떻게 되는지, 진짜 실험함.
lines.img: a big grey rhinoceros hanging upside down by its feet from a yellow crane in a sunny open African savanna, calm scene, bright daylight
a rhinoceros standing on a sunny grassy plain next to a plain shiny golden trophy cup, bright blue sky
a group of twelve grey rhinoceroses standing together on a sunny savanna, bright daylight, wide shot
a strong yellow crane lifting a heavy grey rhinoceros by its feet over a sunny savanna, bright daylight

lines.say: 거꾸로 약 10분. 옆으로 눕힌 것보다 나쁘지 않았음.
lines.sub: 거꾸로 약 10분 · 옆으로 눕힌 것보다 나쁘지 않음
lines.img: a rhinoceros hanging upside down calmly beside a rhinoceros lying on its side on soft grass, sunny savanna, bright daylight
a rhinoceros flying upside down under a helicopter above a bright blue sky and green savanna, cheerful toy-like style

caption: 코뿔소 거꾸로 매단 논문 진짜 있음ㅋㅋ
